shots.alt: The Flocking card in Properties, Effects, with the default swarm: Preset menu showing Free Swarm and a sentence about it, Open Nodes, then the sections Population (a slider and 4000), Behavior (Cohesion, Separation, Alignment, Speed 45, Turbulence 18 with sliders), Appearance (Size and a pale blue Color), the folded More controls, Time & Quality (Step rate 60 Hz, Warm-up 0 s, Loop Continuous) and the folded Simulation status
